analyzed_vuln.description: Integer overflow in size computation during subsetting/serialization of variation regions. VarRegionList::serialize copies axisCount from untrusted source and regionCount from mapping, then computes get_size() as `min_size + VarRegionAxis::static_size * axisCount * regionCount` using 32-bit unsigned arithmetic with no overflow check. If this wraps to a small value (< min_size), `get_size() - min_size` underflows to a huge unsigned value passed to `hb_serialize_context_t::allocate_size`, which then does pointer subtraction/cast and reaches `memset` with a negative size (ASan negative-size-param). Crash happens in allocate_size/memset, but root cause is missing bounds/overflow validation in VarRegionList::serialize size math.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Triggered via hb-subset-fuzzer path that subsets HVAR: `hb_subset` -> HVAR/VVAR `_subset` -> VariationStore::serialize -> VarRegionList::serialize. Malformed font provides HVAR VariationStore/VarRegionList with attacker-controlled `axisCount` and enough mapped regions (`regionCount` from region_map population) so `6 * axisCount * regionCount` overflows 32-bit. This causes wrapped `get_size()` and underflowed allocation length, leading to negative-size memset in serializer buffer allocation.
